name: Jupiter
description: Jupiter is a playful and energetic American Bully who loves to be around people. His joyful demeanor makes him a favorite among visitors.

name: Zeus
description: Zeus is a friendly and outgoing American Bully. He enjoys long walks and is very sociable with other dogs.

name: Athena
description: Athena is a loyal and protective American Bully. She forms strong bonds with her owners and is very affectionate.

name: Apollo
description: Apollo is a young and playful American Bully. He loves to play fetch and is always full of energy.

name: Hera
description: Hera is a gentle and calm American Bully. She enjoys quiet time and is great with children.

name: Ares
description: Ares is a curious and intelligent American Bully. He enjoys exploring new environments and is very observant.

name: Artemis
description: Artemis is an independent American Bully who enjoys her own space but is very affectionate once she knows you.

name: Hades
description: Hades is a mellow and relaxed American Bully. He enjoys lounging around and is very easygoing.

name: Hermes
description: Hermes is an energetic American Bully who loves to run and play. He has a lot of stamina and is very lively.

name: Persephone
description: Persephone is a sweet and affectionate American Bully. She loves to snuggle and is very gentle with everyone she meets.
